releases.name: Chat Derby Desktop
releases.summary: Turn your typing into a race! Play solo or race friends in Steam online rooms, type Korean or English text, and collect cosmetic horse skins. Choose quick one-minute rounds or longer sessions in a compact desktop typing game.

releases.name: Crystal Drive Z
releases.summary: Start your engine and get ready for some fun!This fun and addictive game will have you hooked from the start line!The goal is simple; ride as far as you can getting as many points as possible, but the game is not!How to play?1. Tilt the device right to left to move the car2. Pick all the gas tanks that you can during your journey3. Do all necessary booster upgrades4. Tap the screen to jump away from  obstaclesWith amazing graphics and effects use your control pad to move and jump over obstacles on the way.The further you drive the more challenging the game becomes! Think you are an amazing driver? Prove it!Along the way try to get as many bonus gas and oil tanks as possible! But be careful with the holes, walls and other obstacles along the way; you do not want to crash!So what are you waiting for? Hit the gaaaaas!Enjoy!

releases.name: The Residual
releases.summary: (Warning: Please note that this game is only recommended for 3rd generation iPad and newer, iPhone 4S and newer, and 5th generation iPod Touches.)Put on your fairy helmet. It's time to defend the fairy village from falling stars! Touch the screen where the falling stars will be when the magic seeds fired by your cannons will explode with flower power! You can also double tap the screen to unleash super shots! Don't forget to shoot down blue wisps to get more super shots and red wisps to fix broken fairy houses. You might even fix two houses at once if you shoot down the red wisps just right! Defend the fairy village for a month to beat the game. Or, play for higher scores for bragging rights! Purchase upgrades in the shop to score even higher!

releases.name: Bigger Brain
releases.summary: Test your eyesight by looking at the four points on the photo. Touch the spot of the difference on image. Enjoy to find differences on the image hi-def share your score on game center

releases.name: Eishockey Manager Legacy
releases.summary: Ice hockey management with a desktop interface. Build your roster, scout talent, plan lines and tactics, and follow simulated matches in animated 2D. Face the press, read the newspaper and shape your club in the editor. Big ambitions. Small budget.

releases.name: Cursed Images: What You Shouldn't See
releases.summary:
Could you stay calm when you find what shouldn't be there?

What if an ordinary photo captured something that was never meant to be seen?

Everyday moments can hide an unsettling secret. A casual snapshot may contain a presence, a detail, or a figure that simply does not belong.

Take a close look at each image and search for the one disturbing spot hidden within it.

・Study the photo carefully
・Notice anything that feels out of place
・Click the spot that reveals the answer

The moment you recognize the strange detail, the real shock begins. Can you handle what you find without looking away?

Perfect for fans of paranormal photos, mysteries, urban legends, scary stories, and anyone who enjoys a tense visual puzzle. Play alone for a creepy challenge, or gather friends for a thrilling party session.

If you scare easily, keep the lights on—and take care of any late-night preparations before you play!

releases.name: Nine Lives Deep
releases.summary: Enter the deranged world of the madman known only as "Le boucher de salade"!Potato Salad Adventure is a series of four short interactive scenes that attempt to answer age old questions such as: * How much butter should Potato rub on itself?* Does Egg like the taste of egg?* And, is Parsley actually in love with Onion?Don't miss the finale!Trailer: http://youtu.be/sIaW27ci03Y

releases.name: Me in a Dress!? Femboy Maid: Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Can you spot the secret?

“I’m working as a maid… but it’s a secret.”

Follow the everyday life of a sweet, slightly clumsy boy who dresses up as a maid and does his best to serve others. Each illustration contains one hidden difference on the right half.

releases.name: Cyber Unboxing King
releases.summary: A cyberpunk unboxing strategy game. Wield unique cybernetic augmentations to outmaneuver rivals, unlock mysterious crates to collect all kinds of cyber collectibles, and build your exclusive holographic museum for a perfect mix of tactical planning and random thrills.

releases.name: MIU
releases.summary: MIU is a hand-drawn black-and-white visual novel. On an aimless walk, you meet a girl who has forgotten her name. Spend the day wandering, meeting strange people, and uncovering what she has forgotten. Your choices may lead to 26 different endings.

releases.name: Dino Time Raiders
releases.summary:
Dino Time Raiders is a chaotic blend of time-travel tactics and theme park tycoon madness. 

Assemble your team of questionably qualified scientists, travel back to the prehistoric era, and capture dinosaurs for profit - all while desperately trying not to break the timeline (or your budget).

releases.name: WordBuzz 5
releases.summary:
WordBuzz 5 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

releases.name: FLOW PIPE CODE ~ Connect the Pipes Logic Puzzle ~
releases.summary:
Rotate, connect, solve!

Can you restore the flow?

Remember those puzzles that looked simple until every piece mattered? Turn scattered pipe panels and build a complete route in this approachable logic puzzle.

How to play:
・Check the panels with pipes
・Rotate each panel to adjust its direction
・Create a route where the flow connects correctly

Early stages are easy to read, but later layouts add more pipes and increasingly complex routes. Look at the whole board and think through each move: one turn can change everything that follows.

Whether you enjoy pipe puzzles, rotation puzzles, or thoughtful logic games, there is a challenge waiting for you. Test your insight and problem-solving skills, play a few stages during a short break, or take your time with tougher layouts.

Read the tangled routes, complete every connection, and get the flow moving!

releases.name: DAVE THE DIVER: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Complete Edition contains:
- Dave the Diver
- In the Jungle DLC
- Dredge DLC
- Godzilla DLC
- Ichiban's Holiday DLC
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

releases.name: Anime Fitness - Ninja Workout
releases.summary:
Train with anime ninjas, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense and rewarding full-body worko

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive anime experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

This game will help you to stay active, healthy, and motivated long-term.

releases.name: Foundation: Harvest Festival
releases.summary:
Transform your village into a thriving hub of agriculture with the Harvest Festival DLC.

Raise livestock, cultivate new crops, and plant bountiful orchards as you expand your village’s rural economy with new production chains and resources. Then bring it all together by hosting an increasingly prestigious Harvest Festival, culminating in the grandest celebration in the realm.

releases.name: Curse of Baghdad
releases.summary: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

releases.name: Worm In Winter
releases.summary: Worm adventure continues in winter themed land. Avoid traps and collect stars in this third person walking adventure game and avoid traps

releases.name: Hood Warfare 2
releases.summary: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

releases.name: Train of Thought - Murder on the Silver Line ACADEMIC VERSION
releases.summary: Explore, converse with passengers, solve handcrafted puzzles and connect clues on an interactive deduction board in this narrative-driven mystery adventure set aboard a luxury train line in 1925.

releases.name: Family Number Hunters
releases.summary: Family Number Hunters is a family-friendly game of focus, speed, and mental math. Find numbers, solve math problems, and match pairs. Play solo or take turns competing with family and friends on one computer in free-for-all matches, team contests, and tournaments.
